observations: Photo 0 shows a silver laptop open with the Apple logo on the screen during boot, black keyboard, large trackpad, resting inside a white box.
Photo 1 shows a closed white box with "MacBook Pro" printed on the front and an image of a laptop on the lid.

Photo 2 shows the closed silver laptop with an Apple logo on the lid inside the same white box; a handwritten green sticker on the lid partially lists specs including what appears to be "MacBook Pro M3", "512GB", "18GB", and "Battery Health: 82%".
All photos carry the watermark "POSTED ON JIJI MICHAEL BANKY3W".

claims.evidence: Photo 1 box reads MacBook Pro; 2023 and M3 Pro are not readable from any photo.
Sticker in photo 2 may show 512GB but is blurry and not legible enough to confirm.
Touch ID sensor is not clearly visible in any photo.
Sticker in photo 2 may show 82 but context is unclear.
Seller text is incomplete; photo sticker is not legible enough to confirm battery health.

risks.risk: Battery health is below claimed 82% or degraded.
risks.proof: Screenshot of macOS System Information > Power showing cycle count and battery health.

risks.risk: Chip, RAM, or SSD are lower than M3 Pro / 18GB / 512GB.
risks.proof: Screenshot of About This Mac showing processor, memory, and storage.

risks.risk: Device is iCloud locked, MDM enrolled, or has a firmware password.
risks.proof: Video of unlocking to desktop and signing out of Find My/iCloud.

risks.risk: Box contains a different laptop or is empty.
risks.proof: Video of opening the box and matching the laptop serial to the box.
risks.if_unproven: as box only or mismatched contents.

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage to screen, keyboard, trackpad, or ports.
risks.proof: Close-up video of all exterior angles, keyboard, trackpad, and ports.

proof_requests: Screenshot of About This Mac showing chip, memory, and serial number.
Screenshot of battery health and cycle count.
Video booting to desktop with iCloud signed out.
Clear close-up of the green sticker text.
Video of unboxing and serial match.
response.reason: The photos show an Apple MacBook Pro that boots to the logo, so a worst-case price for a used MacBook Pro that powers on can be set; unverified specs and battery are priced down until proven.
